_comment: LEVEL 5 (stack): a COMPLETE admin product in ONE call — L3 features (auth, RBAC + admin user management, admin-ready CRUD, CSV export, audit trail, uploads, email) + L4 components (layout, login, http-client, full admin CRUD page, dashboard, settings, dropzone) pre-wired, plus CI/gate/deploy. No new code: pure composition.
name: stack-admin
description: Complete admin product: FastAPI backend (JWT auth + RBAC roles + admin user management + admin-ready CRUD + CSV export + audit log + uploads) and React frontend (layout, login, dashboard, full admin CRUD page, settings). One call = full admin app.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'demo_admin' (drives all nested packages)

variables.name: feature_name
variables.description: First CRUD entity managed by the admin page, e.g. 'Product'

notes: Complete admin starter. IMPORTANT: feature_name must NOT be 'User' — the auth feature already owns models/user.py (use 'Product', 'Order', 'Invoice', ...). Backend: set JWT_SECRET + ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env, include ALL routers (auth, admin, {{ feature_name|lower }}, export, audit, upload) in {{ project_name }}/main.py, make sure every model is imported (Base.metadata.create_all runs at app import), seed the first admin at startup (from {{ project_name }}.core.rbac import seed_admin; seed_admin()). Frontend: npm install (react-hook-form, recharts), wrap the app in <ToastProvider> + <ErrorBoundary>, mount: login -> <Layout nav=[...]><Dashboard cards=[{label:'{{ feature_name }}s', fetchPath:'/api/{{ feature_name|lower }}s'}] /> <CrudPage resource='{{ feature_name }}' apiPath='/api/{{ feature_name|lower }}s' exportPath='/api/{{ feature_name|lower }}s/export' .../> <SettingsPage/></Layout>. Manage users via CrudPage at /api/admin/users (role field uses the select field type). CI, security gate, docker and nginx come pre-configured.
